content: Is this the place to post physlib research or not? My previous post was removed.

Hi @anj. This is absolutely the place to talk about Physlib research :). I'm not the person who deleted your post, but the Zulip has strict policies on the use of LLMs to write messages, and I believe it fell foul of those. Would love to have your post here again, just make sure you use your own words.

I've been working on automated physics research with lean+physlib. I've been experimenting with an ai-assisted approach that starts with some postulates and then uses lean to build up effective theories at larger scales. Each effective theory comes with a lean-proved certificate on what regimes it applies to.

It seems promising; in one experiment I was able to start with a polar-dimer crystal and then derive the effective dielectric/surface-mode description.

I reckon you can probably go down to ab-initio level of theory yet still derive useful macroscopic phenomena.

My work is here: https://github.com/anj1/VerifiedEffectiveTheories

I'm sure others must have thought of this approach too, but I haven't seen it mentioned anywhere, hence posting it here. Would love ideas and feedback <3
